This follow-up preserves the historical evidence while binding the exact-handle remediation, identity-committed restart format, performance correction, and final checks to a new immutable commit.

The codex branch was clean after qualification.

evidence: The one-time preview still authorizes only the captured device, inode, size, modification time, regular-file type, and single-link generation. On Windows the adapter opens that exact path with OPEN_REPARSE_POINT and read/delete authority while denying write/delete sharing, validates the held descriptor against the preview, and performs rename and deletion through the same handle. A replacement path generation is therefore skipped and retained rather than moved or deleted.

Project cache/index/model files retain same-volume cleanup staging. Each bounded partial name carries a 96-bit operation token and a full SHA-256 commitment to the preview identity. Restart stats the partial, recomputes the commitment, reacquires that exact identity through a held handle, and fails closed while preserving any mismatch.

The prior categorized accounting, reference/reader rechecks for canonical derived objects, hard quota and free-space admission, shared-cache authority isolation, content-free audit, and read/preview/cleanup continuity remain covered by the exact affected union.

A deterministic adversarial seam exchanges the authorized cache generation immediately before the exact-handle open. Cleanup reports one skip, retains both the previewed bytes at their moved-by-attacker name and the replacement bytes at the authorized path, creates no partial, and restart preserves the replacement.

Restart tests prove that a genuine post-move interruption leaves one identity-committed partial that is deleted on restart, while a crafted partial whose current identity differs from its filename commitment is preserved and prevents store startup from silently continuing.

The exact 52-test union and the registered ten-sample Windows performance gate pass at the final commit. The gate itself also exercises all 2,000 cache files plus 100 derived objects and requires 2,100 reclaimed items with zero skips.

The architecture guide now documents exact-handle destructive authority and SHA-256-committed partial recovery. No portable schema, database migration, public port, UI reference, or shared-cache layout was changed by this remediation.

The implementation remains bounded to release-authoritative Windows x64 behavior. Non-Windows destructive cleanup fails closed pending W6 platform qualification rather than silently falling back to a path-racy operation.

The prior evidence remains immutable and is explicitly superseded rather than edited or treated as approved. Lease and generated planning-state changes reflect the resumed authorized W1 campaign only.

verificationSelection.riskAnalysis: This remediation changes destructive local I/O, a preview-to-delete concurrency boundary, restart cleanup, Windows handle semantics, and the implementation measured by a commit-bound performance gate. The exact storage/encryption/migration/contract union, direct adversarial generation-exchange and restart cases, quality/architecture/governance checks, and full registered Windows storage benchmark were therefore selected. The first exact-handle benchmark attempt exposed a too-long identity-rich partial name: all 2,000 cache candidates were skipped. After compacting it to a full digest commitment, the next complete run reclaimed every item but honestly failed at 5215.349 ms p95. Redundant path rechecks were removed only after showing that OPEN_REPARSE_POINT plus descriptor identity and denied write/delete sharing preserve the same authorization; the final unchanged ten-sample methodology then qualified at 4498.402 ms p95.
verificationSelection.deferred: The complete data profile passed at the original implementation commit and is preserved in the superseded evidence. Replaying its duplicate foundation/build/UI stages is not justified for this bounded remediation because the exact final affected data/contract union and registered performance gate cover every changed executable path. Independent task review must replay the reported generation-exchange finding and incremental restart/performance boundary. Slice review must integrate T01-T03 across encryption, publication/open, upgrade, quota, reference/reader, cleanup, malicious-filesystem, restart, and recovery surfaces; the full affected/full matrix remains due once at W1 exit.
